_note: Daily targets for the 8 tracked micros (PRD-1.2 FR-TGT-4). Values are the US Dietary Reference Intakes (RDA, or AI where no RDA exists), transcribed as facts with citation. Sodium is a limit (Chronic Disease Risk Reduction intake), not a target. 'ul' = Tolerable Upper Intake Level from all food sources where one applies. Unspecified sex uses the lower of the two values, as S19 does for strength standards.
source: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine. Dietary Reference Intakes summary tables (2011, with sodium and potassium updated 2019). Fibre target scales with energy (14 g per 1,000 kcal); the table value is the fallback.
